notablePrerequisites:
"Bear" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
You have a way to draw a card or a bear in hand you can cast.
description:
Activate Words of Wilding.
The next time you would draw a card, create a 2/2 bear token.
Kindred Discovery triggers.
Sacrifice the bear to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Before Kindred Discovery resolves, activate Words of Wilding, replacing your next draw with the creation of a 2/2 bear.
Repeat for infinite colorless mana, then repeat without sacrificing the bears for infinite bears.
